availability: Temporary development service; host PC must remain running.
release_notes: Compact MANUAL GAS / AUTO GAS button in the driving HUD; acceleration choice also appears under Controls.
Auto gas uses an adjustable 140 km/h cruise target. Braking pauses it until GAS is pressed again; menus and focus loss also pause it.
Brakes immediately override accelerator and boost. Forward braking stops the car instead of automatically engaging reverse.
Full steering button travel, faster progressive steering on Android and Windows, and optional automatic corner-speed assistance.
One drift tap makes a short controlled slide, restores rear grip and countersteers during recovery; holding DRIFT does not continuously lock the rear wheels.
Camera-frustum visibility for streamed mobile scenery, with off-screen detail loading reduced, coarse fallbacks and permanent road collisions.
All streamed scene buffers, texture references and UVs audited; mobile Low/Medium/High and all lighting presets rendered without texture or shader errors.
Shared revised handling is advertised by the multiplayer server. Older hosts retain matching legacy prediction; revised hosts require version 0.7.0.
limitations: Real-phone installation, Android + Android and Android + Windows tests remain unverified.
Multiplayer currently needs the host PC running. The temporary server hostname can change; the game checks this website for its current endpoint.
